newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks end easy in blue chip led trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks end easy in blue chip led trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed softer in cautious trade on Wednesday, as investors focused on selected stocks, brokers said.
The all share index closed 1.39 points down at 725.36. Blue chips National Development Bank fell six rupees to 24.
"Focus has narrowed down mainly to blue chips and a few other stocks, as investors wait to see if the all share has bottomed out," said Tivanka Ratnayake of brokerage John Keells.
Colombo stocks have been range-bound since Friday, as investors kept a low profile after the index lost over 13 points in a bout of profit-taking, brokers said.
